Subject: Request: purge all prompt logs, derivative outputs, and related traces for tenant MED-9934

Hi Tessa,

Per our compliance review (SOC2 + internal data minimization policy), MeditaCorp is requesting a full purge of all prompt logs, generated outputs, and inference traces associated with our tenant id MED-9934. We need: 
- removal of prompt input logs and derived tokens from storage/backups
- KV cache expiry for active sessions related to the tenant
- deletion of associated S3/object store artifacts and any indexed traces used for observability

Can you confirm Redwood's workflow and ETA for deletion, and provide a signed manifest or checksum when complete? Attached is our formal request (PDF) and the HR/legal contact to route the acceptance on our side.

Required by: 2026-06-07 (ideally earlier)

Thanks,

MeditaCorp

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Tessa / team — Ops plan below (summary). Will execute when we have Tessa/Marissa approval to proceed and a final signed acceptance from MeditaCorp (they already sent PDF).

Planned steps (high level):
1) Identify keys: query metadata DB for tenant_id = "MED-9934" to enumerate object keys and indexes (approx 6.2k objects).
2) KV cache eviction: trigger eviction API for sessions tagged MED-9934; this will clear in-memory and mark caches for compaction.
3) Delete artifacts: bulk-delete on object store (S3) with versioned deletion where applicable; remove from observability indices (Elasticsearch snapshot) by blacklisting keys and then reindexing affected shards.
4) Backups/snapshots: snapshot sweep required — we will schedule a low-impact rolling cleanup for snapshots older than retention cutoff. Full snapshot purge may take 18–36 hours to fully reconcile; we will provide manifest entries for snapshot deletions as they complete.
5) Proof bundle: generate purge-manifest-ptlog-472B.csv containing enumerated keys, deletion timestamps, and SHA256 checksums; sign with ops PGP key.

Risks/notes:
- Cross-tenant indices: we will not delete shared model weights or compiled kernels — no impact.
- If MeditaCorp requires instant snapshot obliteration, we need a signed DPA addendum (legal) — otherwise we follow standard snapshot lifecycle.

ETA:
- Quick sweep (prompt logs + outputs + caches): 4–6 hours once we start.
- Snapshot reconciliation and manifest finalization: up to 36 hours.

Attachments: purge-manifest-ptlog-472B.csv (will be generated after run)

Will start provisional run at 2026-05-31T02:00:00Z unless you want an earlier slot.

Ben Carter
Senior Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

Ari — thanks for the formal request. Per Ben's plan above, we will: 
- Execute the prompt/output/caches sweep on Monday 2026-06-01 at 02:00 UTC (low-traffic window)
- Provide an initial signed manifest with object keys and deletion timestamps within 6–8 hours of the sweep completion
- Provide snapshot reconciliation proofs within 36 hours; if you require immediate removal from backups, please confirm in writing (we'll route to Legal for DPA addendum).

What we will delete: prompt request logs, derived outputs stored in object storage, KV cache entries, and observability index references tied to MED-9934. We will NOT delete shared model artifacts or compilation caches.

Evidence delivery: purge-manifest-ptlog-472B.csv (SHA256-signed) and a short attestation email from Ops. A sample evidence bundle is linked here: https://redwood.inference/docs/erase-playbook-v2

Please reply with a one-line confirmation to proceed or any objections by EOD Monday; absent an objection, we'll start at the scheduled time.

Best,
